PRIB03M Index.name: Czech Interbank Offered Rates
PRIB03M Index.des_notes:
Czech Interbank Offered Rates 1 Month PRIBOR (or Prague Interbank Offered Rate) is the average interest rate at which unsecured CZK funds are offered by Panel Banks in the interbank market, just prior to 11.00am local time. The calculation of PRIBOR shall take place at 11:00am Prague local time. Individual Panel Bank contributions shall be published at 15:00. Relevant documentation may be found at: https://cfbf.cz/pribor/governance-oversight/code-of-conduct/ and https://cfbf.cz/pribor/

Real-time PRIBOR data is fee-liable. Non-subscribers receive 24-hour delayed data on Terminal. From 1st Jan 2026, a CFBF license is required for delayed Data License access. Non-subscribers will lose access over DL 16th June 2026. Contact subscriptions@cfbf.cz for licensing. Real-time users require EID 74556 . Delayed Data License users require EID 100499.

CZBRREPO Index.name: Czech Republic Ceska Narodni B
CZBRREPO Index.des_notes: A target interest rate set by the central bank in its efforts to influence short-term interest rates as part of its monetary policy strategy. This indicator shows the new target interest rate on the date the new rate went into effect.
